summary: PLF-034: make autonomous completion and action counts truthful

delivery.outcome: PLF-034: autonomous DONE means session ended, not all issues repaired. Distinguish successful execution, failed attempts and dry-run proposals in human reports; centralize dry-run action handling so both heuristic and LLM modes never execute commands during simulation. Label the CLI legacy attempt count as actions while preserving machine-output fields.
nonGoals: No new cleanup targets, live command policy changes, dependencies or machine report schema changes. No changes to protected fleet adoption or deletion of retained worktrees.

architecture.decision: Use a neutral completion message and truthful counts/icons in AgentReport.summary. Move heuristic-only dry-run handling into _handle_exec before command execution so both modes share the guard. Rename the human auto summary attempt label to actions. Preserve FixAction data and JSON schema; use mocked commands and fake LLM responses in tests.
